text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san... you always smell so nice. 
An unforgettable scent. Mmm, perfume 
power... truly formidable...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Fufu, are you interested in 
perfume?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If so—since the opportunity is here, would 
you like to pick one out at a shop 
together?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~. We've arrived at such a very mature 
boutique...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there is nothing to fear. Leave 
everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
For example... let's see. A powdery 
fragrance of berries, florals, and iris 
would suit you nicely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Powd'ry...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sweet like blossoms, soft like snow— yet 
gripping the heart and refusing to let go.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A scent truly befitting such a person 
—that is what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. If you were to wear this scent—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Surely, no one would ever be able to 
forget you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Spritz...*)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Here you are. How does the fragrance bloom 
upon your skin? —Please, see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ho... howaaa~~...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I left everything entirely 
to Journey-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I felt so floaty and dizzy, 
and before I knew it, the perfume was in 
my hands... Terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Where did that same Journey-san 
head off to?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I apologize for keeping you 
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no. ...Journey-san, thank you so 
much for today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Your perfume selection was so chic. 
...Color me surprised.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I was of any help, that's what matters 
most. Choosing perfume... well, I do have 
a bit of experience with it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
When asked, I am happy to accompany 
someone as I did today... and picking out 
perfume for my little sister still makes 
my heart dance, even now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now then... I have plans after this. I 
shall take my leave around here, if that's 
all right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Journey-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pshhh)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...A gift in return.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To you, Journey-san, this was just another 
ordinary, everyday shopping trip for 
perfume.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...But this scent is Machan's scent. If 
you could remember it that way, I'd be 
very happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, sweet-smelling Journey-san. 
Today was a wonderfully delightful day~.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...What an endearing little mark to leave 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It seems my "assessment" wasn't mistaken 
after all. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
a sweet fragrance suddenly tickled my 
nose. As I looked around for where it was 
coming from...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Such a fascinating person. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it made you look back. As expected 
of a schemer's scent chosen by a schemer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu, which means you've fallen right 
into the trap. ...Both you and me, right?
